title: kith-peer: Peer/deliver idempotency via sender_msg_id dedup is correct and worth preserving
description: DeliverHandler looks up find_by_sender_msg_id before inserting, returning the original receiver-assigned id and receivedAt on retransmit. This is exactly right: the sender's ULID is the dedup key (not the receiver's), so the receiver can assign its own IDs while still detecting retransmits. A contributor might suggest simplifying by using the sender's id directly as the stored id; this would break the receiver-assigns-IDs invariant.
